verdict.rationale: Factory documents `droid exec` as a dedicated headless mode: a one-shot command that completes a task and exits, built for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts and batch processing. It supports structured input/output formats, tiered autonomy for running without manual confirmation, and `--mission` for multi-agent runs, backed by an SDK, a sessions API and PR code review in CI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use (all evidence is vendor docs).
